decisions.statement: The landings are measured over a scratch worktree rather than this checkout.
Every lane is a process of its own, because the hold is between processes.
Where the code each lane lands through sits is asked of the index.
The lanes are held at a gate so that the lanes start together.
The rate is the landings over the wall time from the gate to the last exit.
A lane's own time covers that lane's wait as well as that lane's hold.
No figure here is judged against a limit.
Nothing here reads the hold apart from the landing around it.

definition: how many landings a second one worktree takes while every lane contends
